description: Per-agent model routing. Telegram chat uses telegram_model; inbox/work tasks use inbox_model; if a call fails, fallback_model is tried. Pinned explicitly to model IDs to avoid alias ambiguity.

beacon.name: Beacon
beacon.note: Opus everywhere — spec authoring is judgment-heavy and the spec is the contract. Don't economize.

forge.name: Forge
forge.note: Sonnet for chat / routine implementation. Opus for hard tasks (architecture, debugging, security review). Forge can self-escalate to Opus mid-task by setting model in the inbox handshake.

mirror.name: Mirror
mirror.note: Opus for actual reviews. Sonnet acceptable for chat / status queries.

pulse.name: Pulse
pulse.note: Sonnet for routine cycles (cheap polling). Pulse can self-escalate to Opus when investigating a recurring pattern. Default cycle frequency starts at 30 min; tune as we earn trust.

aide.name: Aide
aide.note: EA tasks are mostly mechanical (drafting emails, scheduling, calendar holds). Sonnet handles them well. Opus reserved for ambiguous prioritization calls.

scout.name: Scout
scout.note: Sonnet for chat / Q&A. Opus for actual deep research (competitive analysis, technical deep-dives). Scout's output quality matters — research that misleads is worse than no research.

compass.name: Compass
compass.note: Sequencing across multiple in-flight projects is judgment work. Opus default.

_history.change: Initial creation. Beacon/Forge/Mirror/Pulse defined; Aide/Scout/Compass placeholdered.
